text.p: Ares-Serono Group said it had completed the acquisition of remaining shares in Israel's InterPharm Laboratories Ltd for around $40 million.
"As a result of an investment of roughly $40 million, we are very pleased to own 100 percent of InterPharm," chief executive Ernesto Bertarelli said in a statement.
He said the focus would be on developing its manufacturing capabilities as well as its research and development of recombinant pharmaceuticals.

He said Ares-Serono and its affiliates had invested close to $150 million in InterPharm over the past 15 years. Founded in 1978 by Ares-Serono, InterPharm employs 250 people. Sales figures were not immediately available.

After a tender offer in 1994, Ares-Serono boosted its stake to 87.7 percent from 76.3 percent. It launched a plan in 1996 to acquire the rest of the outstanding shares, and lifted its stake to 99.6 percent.

"On February 10, 1997 the Tel Aviv District Court issued an order providing Ares-Serono with 100 percent ownership of InterPharm and requesting the company to pay to the remaining shareholders $25 per share in cash," it said.
